values..github/workflows/snapshot.yml:
name: Snapshot job boards

# GitHub-hosted runners can reach the public job-board APIs. This workflow
# fetches every built-in board and uploads data/snapshots/*.json as a workflow
# ARTIFACT. It does not commit them: real snapshots are tens of MB per day
# (anduril alone is ~38 MB), which would bloat the git history. pages.yml
# restores the latest artifact as its fallback before fetching fresh data.
#
# Beta channel (docs/process/beta-deploy.md): the big-tech boards are crawled
# here, never in pages.yml (a full crawl takes over an hour: about 1 request/s per
# host, and Amazon alone has ~22k postings). Every 6 hours:
#   beta-companies  the beta slugs from server/companies.js (the matrix)
#   beta-crawl      one job per company, in parallel (each a different host, so the
#                   per-host politeness holds), capped; its snapshot is vetted (the
#                   per-company beta gate) and only a passing one is handed on
#   beta-merge      the previous job-board-snapshots-beta artifact + this run's
#                   results: a company whose crawl failed keeps its previous file;
#                   the beta ledger is updated; one artifact uploaded
#   beta-deploy     dispatches pages.yml, so fresh posts go live without a push (a
#                   dispatched deploy makes no branch build, so no holding page)
# The stable job (daily) is unchanged and never waits on or depends on these.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 6 * * *" # stable boards, daily, 06:17 UTC
    - cron: "47 0,6,12,18 * * *" # beta (big-tech) boards, every 6 hours at :47 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      channel:
        description: Which boards to fetch
        type: choice
        options: [both, stable, beta]
        default: both

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read # find the newest history-ledger / beta snapshots artifact

# Ledger artifacts are only restored from trusted runs (REVIEW.md V2).
env:
  TRUSTED_BRANCHES: claude/stoic-ride-54ddxp

concurrency:
  group: snapshot
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  snapshot:
    if: ${{ github.event.schedule == '17 6 * * *' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.channel != 'beta') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      # F4 history ledger (data/history/*.json): restore it before the snapshot
      # step updates it. Store: HISTORY_STORE repo variable, `artifact` (default:
      # newest non-expired `history-ledger` artifact from either workflow) or
      # `branch` (orphan data-history branch). Missing = start fresh.
      # See .github/scripts/ledger.sh and README "History ledger".
      - name: Restore history ledger
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HISTORY_STORE: ${{ vars.HISTORY_STORE || 'artifact' }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore

      - name: Fetch snapshots
        id: fetch
        run: npm run snapshot # no args = every built-in in server/companies.js; also updates data/history/

      # Always upload the updated ledger (also the hand-off to persist-ledger in
      # branch mode), even if a later step such as the vetting gate fails.
      - name: Upload history ledger
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: history-ledger
          path: data/history/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn

      # Salary vetting gate: same command as pages.yml. A critical anomaly fails
      # this job (red run + step summary). The raw artifact is still uploaded
      # (below, `if: !cancelled()`) for review and as pages.yml's fallback;
      # pages.yml re-runs this gate, so bad pay still can't be published.
      - name: Salary vetting gate (fails on critical anomalies)
        id: vet
        continue-on-error: false
        run: node scripts/vet-salaries.js --no-write-flags --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Upload snapshots artifact
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: job-board-snapshots
          path: data/snapshots/*.json
          retention-days: 90 # GitHub maximum; the permanent copy is the data-archive branch (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md)
          if-no-files-found: error

  # Branch store only (HISTORY_STORE=branch): commit the ledger to the orphan
  # data-history branch. The only job with contents: write, and it is skipped
  # entirely in the default artifact store (and on beta-only runs).
  persist-ledger:
    needs: snapshot
    if: ${{ vars.HISTORY_STORE == 'branch' && !cancelled() && needs.snapshot.result != 'skipped' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    concurrency:
      group: history-ledger-branch
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: history-ledger
          path: data/history
      - name: Commit ledger to the data-history branch
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh commit-branch

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- beta channel

  beta-companies:
    if: ${{ github.event.schedule == '47 0,6,12,18 * * *' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.channel != 'stable') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      slugs: ${{ steps.list.outputs.slugs }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Beta companies (server/companies.js)
        id: list
        run: |
          slugs=$(node .github/scripts/beta-snapshots.mjs slugs)
          echo "slugs=$slugs" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Beta companies to crawl: $slugs" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # One crawl per company, in parallel. A failed or timed-out crawl, or one the beta
  # gate rejects, uploads nothing, so the merge keeps that company's previous file.
  beta-crawl:
    name: beta crawl (${{ matrix.slug }})
    needs: beta-companies
    if: ${{ needs.beta-companies.outputs.slugs != '' && needs.beta-companies.outputs.slugs != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 150
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        slug: ${{ fromJSON(needs.beta-companies.outputs.slugs) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      # The ledger is recorded by beta-merge, against the previous one; this run's copy is scratch.
      - name: Crawl (polite, about 1 request/s; capped at 140 min)
        id: crawl
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          SLUG: ${{ matrix.slug }}
          MELON_SNAPSHOT_DIR: data/beta-fresh
          MELON_HISTORY_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/ledger-scratch
        run: timeout --kill-after=60s 140m node scripts/snapshot.js "$SLUG"

      - name: Crawl did not finish (the previous snapshot stays on /beta/)
        if: ${{ steps.crawl.outcome != 'success' }}
        env:
          SLUG: ${{ matrix.slug }}
        run: echo "::warning::beta crawl of $SLUG failed or timed out; the beta site keeps its previous $SLUG snapshot"

      # Beta gate (per company): a snapshot with an unquarantined critical salary is moved aside.
      - name: Beta salary vetting gate
        env:
          BETA_GATE_TIMEOUT: "300"
        run: bash .github/scripts/beta-gate.sh data/beta-fresh "$RUNNER_TEMP/beta-rejected"

      - name: Hand the snapshot to the merge
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: beta-crawl-${{ matrix.slug }}
          path: data/beta-fresh/*.json
          retention-days: 90 # GitHub maximum; the permanent copy is the data-archive branch (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md)
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  beta-merge:
    needs: [beta-companies, beta-crawl]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.beta-companies.result == 'success' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      fresh: ${{ steps.merge.outputs.fresh }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      # data/beta/snapshots/ + data/beta/history/ as the last run left them (trusted runs only).
      - name: Restore last beta snapshots artifact (trusted runs only)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LEDGER_ARTIFACT: job-board-snapshots-beta
          LEDGER_DIR: data/beta
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore-artifact

      - name: Download this run's crawls
        continue-on-error: true # no company produced a snapshot
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: beta-crawl-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: data/beta-fresh

      - name: Merge (fresh replaces previous; a failed company keeps its previous file)
        id: merge
        run: node .github/scripts/beta-snapshots.mjs merge data/beta-fresh data/beta

      - name: Upload beta snapshots artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: job-board-snapshots-beta
          path: data/beta/
          retention-days: 90 # GitHub maximum; the permanent copy is the data-archive branch (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md)
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # Fresh beta posts go live: dispatch pages.yml (it restores the artifact above). Dispatched
  # runs make no branch-based Pages build, so the holding page never shows.
  beta-deploy:
    needs: beta-merge
    if: ${{ needs.beta-merge.result == 'success' && fromJSON(needs.beta-merge.outputs.fresh || '0') > 0 }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      actions: write # dispatch pages.yml; read its runs to find the deployed branch
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch pages.yml on the deployed branch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          default=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq .default_branch)
          branch=$(gh run list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow pages.yml --status success --limit 1 \
                     --json headBranch --jq '.[0].headBranch // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)
          # Only a trusted branch (the default or TRUSTED_BRANCHES) is ever deployed.
          case " $default $TRUSTED_BRANCHES " in
            *" $branch "*) [ -n "$branch" ] || branch="$default" ;;
            *) branch="$default" ;;
          esac
          gh workflow run pages.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref "$branch"
          echo "Dispatched pages.yml on \`$branch\`: the fresh beta snapshots go live at /beta/ when it finishes." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
values..github/workflows/pages.yml:
name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

# Static build of melon-seek (no server) published to
# https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/ . Every run fetches fresh snapshots
# from the live boards (GitHub runners can reach them). Snapshots are not
# committed to git; the latest snapshot.yml artifact is restored first, so a
# board that fails during this run keeps its last good data instead of
# falling back to demo.
#
# Beta site (docs/CONTRACT.md "v3 additions", docs/process/beta-deploy.md): the
# same deploy also publishes https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/beta/, a full
# copy of the app with the stable companies plus the big-tech boards. This
# workflow never crawls the big-tech boards (a full crawl takes over an hour):
# it restores the latest trusted job-board-snapshots-beta artifact, which
# snapshot.yml crawls every 6 hours and then deploys by dispatching this
# workflow. So a push deploy costs what it did before plus a few beta minutes
# (restore, per-company gate, beta copy), each step best effort and time-capped;
# a beta failure only removes that company, or the whole /beta/ copy, with a
# warning. It never fails or changes the stable site.
#
# One-time repo setup: Settings -> Pages -> Source: "GitHub Actions".
# To deploy from a non-default branch, also allow it under
# Settings -> Environments -> github-pages -> Deployment branches and tags.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, claude/stoic-ride-54ddxp]
  workflow_dispatch: # also sent by snapshot.yml after each beta crawl (and by site-watchdog.yml)
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 7 * * *" # daily, 07:41 UTC (after snapshot.yml's 06:17 run)

# Least privilege (REVIEW.md V12): the build job (npm ci, network fetches,
# restored artifacts, LLM step) only reads. pages/id-token are granted to the
# deploy job alone; persist-ledger has its own contents: write.
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read # look up and download trusted snapshot/ledger artifacts

# Artifacts are only restored from push/schedule/workflow_dispatch runs of this
# repo on the default branch or these (REVIEW.md V2; .github/scripts/ledger.sh).
env:
  TRUSTED_BRANCHES: claude/stoic-ride-54ddxp

# One deployment at a time; don't cancel an in-progress deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      # Fallback data for boards that fail below: the newest job-board-snapshots
      # artifact from a TRUSTED run only (never a PR or fork run; REVIEW.md V2).
      - name: Restore last snapshots artifact (trusted runs only)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LEDGER_ARTIFACT: job-board-snapshots
          LEDGER_DIR: data/snapshots
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore-artifact

      # Beta: data/beta/snapshots/ + data/beta/history/ (never data/snapshots/, so the
      # stable gate and the stable artifact never see beta data), as snapshot.yml's beta
      # crawl left them. Same trust rules. Nothing here crawls a big-tech board.
      - name: Restore last beta snapshots artifact (trusted runs only; best effort)
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LEDGER_ARTIFACT: job-board-snapshots-beta
          LEDGER_DIR: data/beta
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore-artifact

      # F4 history ledger (data/history/*.json): restore it before the snapshot
      # step updates it. Store: HISTORY_STORE repo variable, `artifact` (default:
      # newest non-expired `history-ledger` artifact from either workflow) or
      # `branch` (orphan data-history branch). Missing = start fresh.
      # See .github/scripts/ledger.sh and README "History ledger".
      - name: Restore history ledger
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HISTORY_STORE: ${{ vars.HISTORY_STORE || 'artifact' }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore

      - name: Fetch fresh snapshots (best effort; a failed board keeps the restored file)
        run: npm run snapshot || true # no args = every built-in in server/companies.js; also updates data/history/

      # Always upload the updated ledger (also the hand-off to persist-ledger in
      # branch mode), even if a later step such as the vetting gate fails.
      - name: Upload history ledger
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: history-ledger
          path: data/history/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: warn

      # Salary vetting gate (docs/VETTING.md). HARD gate: no existence guard and
      # no continue-on-error, so a non-zero exit (any job that would be published
      # with a critical salary, or a failing regression fixture) skips the build
      # and the deploy. Implausible pay is never published.
      - name: Salary vetting gate (fails on critical anomalies)
        continue-on-error: false
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/vetting"
          node scripts/vet-salaries.js --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/vetting/flags.jsonl" --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      # Advisory LLM review of flagged salaries. Does nothing without an
      # ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret and never blocks the deploy.
      - name: LLM salary review (advisory; no-op without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
        if: always()
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          VET_LLM_MODEL: ${{ vars.VET_LLM_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-5-5' }}
        run: node scripts/llm-vet.js --flags "$RUNNER_TEMP/vetting/flags.jsonl" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/vetting/llm-verdicts.jsonl" --skip-reviewed --limit 100

      - name: Upload salary vetting report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: salary-vetting
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/vetting
          retention-days: 90 # GitHub maximum; the permanent copy is the data-archive branch (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md)

      # Beta gate (docs/process/beta-deploy.md): the same vetting scan, per beta company, each
      # with a time limit (snapshot.yml already gated each snapshot when it was crawled; this
      # re-checks the restored copy with today's rules, about 3 s per 40 MB). A failing company
      # is moved to data/beta/rejected/ (left out of /beta/, listed in the summary); the step
      # itself always passes. The stable gate above is unchanged.
      - name: Beta salary vetting gate (per company; a failure only drops that company from /beta/)
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          BETA_GATE_TIMEOUT: "120"
        run: bash .github/scripts/beta-gate.sh data/beta/snapshots data/beta/rejected

      # Warn-only staleness gate (docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md): a step-summary table of every
      # dataset's age plus a warning per entry past its cadence + grace. Never blocks the deploy.
      - name: Data freshness (warn only, never blocks the deploy)
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: node scripts/refresh/run.js --staleness

      - name: Build static site
        env:
          # Base for the absolute og:url / og:image / twitter:image link-preview
          # tags (docs/process/social.md). Set the SITE_URL repo variable to
          # override it (fork, custom domain).
          SITE_URL: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
        run: npm run build -- --no-beta # the stable site; the beta copy is the next step

      # dist/beta/ (served at SITE_URL/beta/): stable companies (the main site's files, copied)
      # + the beta companies that passed. Its own step, capped and best effort, so it can't fail
      # or hold up the stable deploy.
      - name: Build beta site (best effort; dist/beta/)
        id: beta_build
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 10
        env:
          SITE_URL: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
          MELON_BETA_SNAPSHOT_DIR: data/beta/snapshots
          MELON_BETA_HISTORY_DIR: data/beta/history
        run: node scripts/build-static.js --beta-only --beta-summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Beta site not built (this deploy has no /beta/; the main site is unaffected)
        if: ${{ steps.beta_build.outcome != 'success' }}
        env:
          OUTCOME: ${{ steps.beta_build.outcome }}
        run: |
          rm -rf dist/beta
          msg="The beta site could not be built (step outcome: $OUTCOME), so this deploy has no /beta/. The main site is unaffected."
          echo "::warning::$msg"
          { echo "### Beta site NOT built"; echo ""; echo "$msg"; echo ""; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Check link-preview tags (absolute og:url / og:image, image bundled)
        env:
          SITE_URL: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          grep -oE '<meta (property|name)="(og|twitter):[a-z:_]+" content="[^"]*"' dist/index.html
          img=$(sed -n 's/.*property="og:image" content="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' dist/index.html | head -1)
          case "$img" in
            "${SITE_URL%/}"/*) ;;
            *) echo "::error::og:image '$img' is not an absolute URL under SITE_URL ($SITE_URL)"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          for k in 'property="og:url" content="https://' 'name="twitter:image" content="https://' 'name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"'; do
            grep -qF "$k" dist/index.html || { echo "::error::dist/index.html is missing: $k"; exit 1; }
          done
          file dist/og/melon-seek-og.png | grep -q 'PNG image data, 1200 x 630' || { echo "::error::dist/og/melon-seek-og.png missing or not 1200x630"; exit 1; }
          {
            echo "### Link previews"
            echo ""
            echo "og:image: $img"
            echo ""
            for f in dist/c/*/index.html; do
              echo "- \`c/$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")/\`: $(sed -n 's/.*property="og:title" content="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$f")"
            done
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Summarize bundle
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Bundled data"
            echo ""
            echo "| company | mode | jobs | list | descriptions | fetchedAt |"
            echo "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"
            for f in dist/api/jobs/*.json; do
              slug=$(basename "$f" .json)
              list_kb=$(( $(stat -c %s "$f") / 1000 ))
              desc_n=$(find "dist/api/desc/$slug" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
              desc_kb=$(( $(du -sb "dist/api/desc/$slug" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1 || echo 0) / 1000 ))
              jq -r --arg l "$list_kb" --arg n "$desc_n" --arg d "$desc_kb" \
                '"| \(.company.slug) | \(.mode) | \(.jobs | length) | \($l) kB | \($n) files, \($d) kB | \(.fetchedAt) |"' "$f"
            done
            echo ""
            echo "Site total: $(( $(du -sb dist | cut -f1) / 1000000 )) MB (GitHub Pages limit: 1 GB)"
            if [ -d dist/beta ]; then
              echo ""
              echo "Beta copy (dist/beta/, included in the total): $(( $(du -sb dist/beta | cut -f1) / 1000000 )) MB, $(jq length dist/beta/api/companies.json) companies"
            fi
            echo ""
            echo "### Compstimate backtest (meta.compstimate; seeded leave-one-out, percent values)"
            echo ""
            echo "| company | n | median abs % error | within 10% | seed | history (since, runs) |"
            echo "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |"
            for f in dist/api/jobs/*.json; do
              jq -r '(.meta.compstimate // {}) as $c | (.meta.history // {}) as $h |
                "| \(.company.slug) | \($c.n // "-") | \(if $c.medianAbsPctError == null then "-" else ($c.medianAbsPctError | tostring) + "%" end) | \(if $c.within10Pct == null then "-" else ($c.within10Pct | tostring) + "%" end) | \($c.seed // "-") | \($h.since // "-"), \($h.runs // 0) |"' "$f"
            done
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/configure-pages@45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d # v6.0.0

      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5.0.0
        with:
          path: dist
          include-hidden-files: true # keep dist/.nojekyll (v4+ drops dotfiles by default)

  # Branch store only (HISTORY_STORE=branch): commit the ledger to the orphan
  # data-history branch. The only job with contents: write, and it is skipped
  # entirely in the default artifact store.
  persist-ledger:
    needs: build
    if: ${{ vars.HISTORY_STORE == 'branch' && !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    concurrency:
      group: history-ledger-branch
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: history-ledger
          path: data/history
      - name: Commit ledger to the data-history branch
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh commit-branch

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
      actions: read    # see whether GitHub's own branch-based Pages build is running
      contents: read   # sparse checkout of .github/scripts
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      SITE: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
          persist-credentials: false

      # While Settings -> Pages -> Source is "Deploy from a branch", GitHub runs
      # its own "pages build and deployment" on every push and publishes the
      # README, racing this deploy. Wait until it is done so the app lands last.
      # The real fix is Source = "GitHub Actions" (needs an admin).
      - name: Wait for GitHub's branch-based Pages build (it would overwrite the app)
        run: bash .github/scripts/wait-pages-build.sh

      - name: Deploy
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5.0.1

      # HARD check: the live site must be THIS build of the app (marker
      # <meta name="melon-seek-build" content="<sha>">), not the README.
      - name: Verify the live site is the app (not the README)
        id: verify
        continue-on-error: true
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-site.sh "$SITE" "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Wait again before re-deploying
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'failure'
        run: bash .github/scripts/wait-pages-build.sh

      - name: Re-deploy once
        id: redeploy
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5.0.1

      - name: Verify again (fails the job)
        if: steps.verify.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          if bash .github/scripts/check-site.sh "$SITE" "$GITHUB_SHA"; then
            echo "Recovered after one re-deploy (${{ steps.verify.outputs.result }} at first)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 0
          fi
          msg="The live site is not the app after deploy + one re-deploy (${{ steps.verify.outputs.detail }}). Most likely GitHub Pages is still set to 'Deploy from a branch', so GitHub publishes the README on every push. FIX: Settings -> Pages -> Build and deployment -> Source: GitHub Actions."
          echo "::error::$msg"
          { echo "### Live site check FAILED"; echo ""; echo "$msg"; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          exit 1

      # Warn-only: confirms crawlers can fetch the live og:image as image/png.
      # LinkedIn etc. cache previews; re-scrape with
      # https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/ (docs/process/social.md).
      - name: Check live link preview
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          PAGE_URL: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
        run: |
          img=''; type=''
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            # A fresh query string skips the CDN's cached copy of the page.
            img=$(curl -fsSL "${PAGE_URL}?og-check=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${i}" | sed -n 's/.*property="og:image" content="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)
            type=''
            [ -n "$img" ] && type=$(curl -fsSIL "$img" | tr -d '\r' | awk -F': *' 'tolower($1) == "content-type" { t = $2 } END { print t }')
            if [ "$type" = "image/png" ]; then echo "og:image $img is live ($type)"; exit 0; fi
            echo "attempt $i: og:image='$img' content-type='$type'; retrying in 20s"; sleep 20
          done
          echo "::warning::Live link preview check failed: og:image='$img' content-type='$type' (docs/process/social.md)"
          exit 1

      # Warn-only: /beta/ is this build's beta copy (marker + <meta name="melon-channel"
      # content="beta">). A beta outage is a warning annotation, never a failed deploy.
      - name: Verify the beta site (warning only)
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          EXPECT_CHANNEL: beta
          CHECK_LEVEL: warning
          CHECK_TIMEOUT: "120"
        run: |
          if ! bash .github/scripts/check-site.sh "${SITE%/}/beta/" "$GITHUB_SHA"; then
            { echo "### Beta site check (warning)"; echo ""; echo "${SITE%/}/beta/ is not this build's beta site (see the build job's \"Beta site\" summary). The main site is unaffected."; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
values..github/workflows/site-watchdog.yml:
name: Site watchdog

# Every 30 min (and on demand): is https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/ the
# melon-seek APP from the latest successful pages.yml deploy? If GitHub's
# README page (branch-based Pages build) or a wrong build is being served, it
# re-runs pages.yml and reports the problem in the job summary.
# Root cause it guards against: Settings -> Pages -> Source = "Deploy from a
# branch" (fix: Source = "GitHub Actions"; needs an admin, so this can't do it).
# It also checks the beta copy at <site>/beta/ (docs/process/beta-deploy.md):
# a beta problem is a warning annotation only (no re-deploy, no failed run).
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "11,41 * * * *" # every 30 min, off the hour
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write   # dispatch pages.yml
  contents: read   # sparse checkout of .github/scripts

concurrency:
  group: site-watchdog
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      SITE: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Expected build (latest successful pages.yml deploy)
        id: expect
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          busy=$(gh run list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow pages.yml --limit 20 --json status \
                   --jq '[.[] | select(.status != "completed")] | length')
          echo "busy=$busy" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          read -r sha branch < <(gh run list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --workflow pages.yml --status success --limit 1 \
                                   --json headSha,headBranch --jq '.[0] | "\(.headSha // "") \(.headBranch // "")"')
          echo "sha=${sha:-}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "branch=${branch:-}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Latest successful deploy: ${sha:-none} on ${branch:-?}; pages.yml runs in flight: $busy"

      - name: Check the live site
        id: check
        if: steps.expect.outputs.busy == '0'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          CHECK_TIMEOUT: "60"
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-site.sh "$SITE" "${{ steps.expect.outputs.sha }}"

      - name: Check the beta site (warning only)
        if: steps.expect.outputs.busy == '0'
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          CHECK_TIMEOUT: "60"
          EXPECT_CHANNEL: beta
          CHECK_LEVEL: warning
          EXPECTED: ${{ steps.expect.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          if ! bash .github/scripts/check-site.sh "${SITE%/}/beta/" "$EXPECTED"; then
            { echo "### Beta site check (warning)"; echo ""; echo "- URL: ${SITE%/}/beta/"; echo "- The main site is checked separately; a beta outage never re-deploys or fails this run."; echo ""; } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi

      - name: Deploy in progress
        if: steps.expect.outputs.busy != '0'
        run: echo "A pages.yml run is in flight; skipping this check (it verifies the site itself)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Re-deploy and report
        if: steps.check.outcome == 'failure'
        env:
          RESULT: ${{ steps.check.outputs.result }}
          DETAIL: ${{ steps.check.outputs.detail }}
          BRANCH: ${{ steps.expect.outputs.branch }}
        run: |
          ref="${BRANCH:-${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}}"
          dispatched="no"
          if gh workflow run pages.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref "$ref"; then dispatched="yes (ref $ref)"; fi
          {
            echo "### Live site is NOT the app"
            echo ""
            echo "- URL: $SITE"
            echo "- Problem: ${RESULT:-unknown}, ${DETAIL:-no detail}"
            echo "- Re-ran pages.yml: $dispatched"
            echo ""
            if [ "$RESULT" = "readme" ]; then
              echo "GitHub is publishing the README from a branch. Permanent fix: **Settings -> Pages -> Build and deployment -> Source: GitHub Actions**."
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "::error::Live site is not the app ($RESULT: $DETAIL); re-ran pages.yml: $dispatched"
          exit 1
values..github/workflows/monthly-refresh.yml:
name: Monthly data refresh

# Monthly refresh of every reference number the product shows, cites or computes
# from: FX, Big Mac prices, rents, cost index, the NYC living-cost baseline, tax
# rules, and the models built on job data (market comps, Compstimate backtest,
# vetting health, lexicon coverage). The registry is data/freshness.json; the
# runbook is docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md. Job postings themselves are refreshed daily
# by snapshot.yml / pages.yml and are only health-checked here.
#
# scripts/refresh/run.js runs one updater per data family (scripts/refresh/*.js):
#   auto    fetch + validate + diff; validated changes become a REVIEW PR
#   detect  compare the official source with the encoded values; a mismatch or a
#           newly published tax/data year becomes a GitHub ISSUE with the evidence
#   manual  past-due entries are listed in the same issue with their checklist
# Safety model (REVIEW.md V12, as col-refresh.yml before it): nothing is ever
# pushed to the default/deploy branch. Changes go to the bot/monthly-refresh
# branch and a pull request for a human to review; merging it deploys.
#
# Repo settings this needs (the workflow degrades gracefully without them):
#   - Settings -> Actions -> General -> Workflow permissions ->
#     "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" (to open the PR;
#     without it the branch is pushed and the run says to open the PR by hand).
#   - Optional secrets: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (advisory LLM read of tax pages),
#     HUD_API_TOKEN (HUD USER API for US rents), BLS_API_KEY (BLS API v2 limits).
# PRs opened with GITHUB_TOKEN don't trigger CI; re-run CI from the PR (or push to it).
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 3 * *" # monthly, 05:17 UTC on the 3rd (after ECB/Fed monthly averages are out)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      only:
        description: "Comma-separated updater modules or registry ids (empty = everything)"
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
      dry_run:
        description: "Report only: no branch, PR or issue"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: monthly-refresh
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  TRUSTED_BRANCHES: claude/stoic-ride-54ddxp
  REVIEW_BRANCH: bot/monthly-refresh
  ISSUE_LABEL: data-freshness

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: write      # push the bot/monthly-refresh review branch (never the default branch)
      pull-requests: write # open / update the review PR
      issues: write        # open / update the data-freshness issue
      actions: read        # restore the latest trusted job-board snapshot artifact
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install pdftotext (official tax schedules are often PDFs)
        run: command -v pdftotext || (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq poppler-utils > /dev/null)

      # The job-data checks (market comps, Compstimate backtest, vetting health)
      # read the newest snapshots. Trusted runs only (REVIEW.md V2). Best effort:
      # without them those checks report 'skipped'.
      - name: Restore last snapshots artifact (trusted runs only)
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LEDGER_ARTIFACT: job-board-snapshots
          LEDGER_DIR: data/snapshots
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore-artifact

      - name: Restore history ledger (best effort)
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          HISTORY_STORE: ${{ vars.HISTORY_STORE || 'artifact' }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore

      - name: Restore last beta snapshots artifact (trusted runs only; best effort)
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          LEDGER_ARTIFACT: job-board-snapshots-beta
          LEDGER_DIR: data/beta
        run: bash .github/scripts/ledger.sh restore-artifact

      # Last month's archived aggregates are the baseline for the month-over-month
      # checks (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md). Read-only worktree; without it the checks
      # fall back to absolute bounds and say so.
      - name: Check out the data archive (read-only baseline; best effort)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          if git fetch --depth=1 origin data-archive 2>/dev/null; then
            git worktree add --detach tmp/archive FETCH_HEAD
          else
            echo "No data-archive branch yet; month-over-month checks use absolute bounds."
          fi

      # The archive (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md) keeps every version of every dataset forever.
      # BEFORE the refresh touches anything, export the current (live, merged) value of each
      # registry dataset; archive.yml imports tmp/refresh/ (report, archive/ and reference/
      # manifests) from the uploaded artifact into the data-archive branch. Proposed changes
      # in the review PR are archived once merged (the archive's capture of the code branch).
      - name: Export the current reference datasets for the archive
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/refresh/run.js --export-reference tmp/refresh/reference

      - name: Refresh (fetch, validate, diff)
        id: refresh
        env:
          MELON_ARCHIVE_DIR: tmp/archive
          MELON_BETA_SNAPSHOT_DIR: data/beta/snapshots
          MELON_BETA_HISTORY_DIR: data/beta/history
          ONLY: ${{ inputs.only }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          HUD_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUD_API_TOKEN }}
          BLS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BLS_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--out tmp/refresh)
          if [ -n "${ONLY:-}" ]; then args+=(--only "$ONLY"); fi
          if [ "${DRY_RUN:-false}" = "true" ]; then args+=(--dry-run); fi
          node scripts/refresh/run.js "${args[@]}" > tmp-refresh.log 2>&1 || { cat tmp-refresh.log; exit 1; }
          tail -n 40 tmp-refresh.log
          node -e '
            const o = require("./tmp/refresh/outcome.json");
            const out = require("fs").createWriteStream(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, { flags: "a" });
            out.write(`files=${o.files.length}\nalerts=${o.alerts + o.problems}\n`);
            out.end();
            console.log(`files changed: ${o.files.length}, alerts: ${o.alerts}, problems: ${o.problems}`);
          '

      # The suite runs against the refreshed data, so a PR shows which tests a
      # data change breaks (e.g. worked examples pinned to old FX). Never blocks
      # the PR: a human decides.
      - name: Tests against the refreshed data (advisory)
        id: tests
        if: steps.refresh.outputs.files != '0' && inputs.dry_run != true
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm test 2>&1 | tee tmp/refresh/npm-test.log | tail -n 25
          echo "Tests passed against the refreshed data." > tmp/refresh/tests.md

      - name: Note failing tests
        if: steps.refresh.outputs.files != '0' && inputs.dry_run != true && steps.tests.outcome == 'failure'
        run: |
          {
            echo "**Tests FAILED against the refreshed data.** Review before merging; failing tests may pin old values (see docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md, 'Pinned values')."
            echo
            echo '```'
            grep -E '^not ok|^# (pass|fail)' tmp/refresh/npm-test.log | head -n 40 || true
            echo '```'
          } > tmp/refresh/tests.md

      - name: Upload the report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: monthly-refresh-report
          path: tmp/refresh/
          retention-days: 90
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Push the review branch and open a PR (never the default branch)
        if: steps.refresh.outputs.files != '0' && inputs.dry_run != true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          branch="$REVIEW_BRANCH"
          day=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
          # Stage exactly the files the orchestrator reported (never `git add -A`).
          node -e 'for (const f of require("./tmp/refresh/outcome.json").files) console.log(f)' > tmp/refresh/files.txt
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git switch -c "$branch"
          xargs -a tmp/refresh/files.txt -d '\n' git add --
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo "No changes to commit."; exit 0; fi
          git commit -m "chore(data): monthly refresh of reference data ($day)" -m "Generated by .github/workflows/monthly-refresh.yml (scripts/refresh/run.js). See the PR body for the report."
          git push --force origin "$branch"
          { cat tmp/refresh/tests.md 2>/dev/null || true; echo; cat tmp/refresh/summary.md; } | head -c 64000 > tmp/refresh/pr-body.md
          base="${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}"
          if gh pr view "$branch" --json state --jq .state 2>/dev/null | grep -q OPEN; then
            gh pr edit "$branch" --title "chore(data): monthly data refresh ($day)" --body-file tmp/refresh/pr-body.md
            echo "Updated the open PR for $branch."
          elif gh pr create --base "$base" --head "$branch" --title "chore(data): monthly data refresh ($day)" --body-file tmp/refresh/pr-body.md; then
            echo "Opened a PR for $branch."
          else
            echo "::warning::Pushed $branch but could not open a PR (enable Settings -> Actions -> General -> 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests', or open it by hand)."
          fi

      - name: Open or update the data-freshness issue (drift, flags, stale entries, errors)
        if: inputs.dry_run != true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ALERTS: ${{ steps.refresh.outputs.alerts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          day=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
          head -c 64000 tmp/refresh/summary.md > tmp/refresh/issue-body.md
          open=$(gh issue list --label "$ISSUE_LABEL" --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number' 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ "${ALERTS:-0}" = "0" ]; then
            if [ -n "$open" ]; then
              gh issue comment "$open" --body "Monthly refresh $day: no drift, flags, stale entries or errors. Closing." && gh issue close "$open" --reason completed || true
            fi
            echo "No alerts."
            exit 0
          fi
          gh label create "$ISSUE_LABEL" --color FBCA04 --description "Reference data needs a human (docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md)" 2>/dev/null || true
          title="Data freshness: $ALERTS item(s) need review ($day)"
          if [ -n "$open" ]; then
            gh issue edit "$open" --title "$title" --body-file tmp/refresh/issue-body.md
            gh issue comment "$open" --body "Monthly refresh $day updated this issue: $ALERTS item(s). Run: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
          else
            gh issue create --title "$title" --label "$ISSUE_LABEL" --body-file tmp/refresh/issue-body.md
          fi
values..github/workflows/archive.yml:
name: Archive (daily ingest into the data branch)

# The permanent historical database (docs/DATA_ARCHIVE.md). After every run of
# "Snapshot job boards", "Deploy to GitHub Pages" and "Monthly data refresh" (and
# daily as a safety net) it:
#   1. sweeps every trusted artifact that is not in the archive yet (job-board
#      snapshots, the F4 ledger, salary-vetting reports, reference-data hand-offs) and
#      folds each into the append-only archive;
#   2. records a new dated version of every reference dataset the code branch defines
#      (FX, cities.json rents and cost index, the Juice/tax model, policy constants)
#      when it changed;
#   3. freezes the monthly cross-company comparisons of every month that is complete;
#   4. writes the monthly report of each complete month, the annual review of the year
#      (year to date), and in January the final review of the year before;
#   5. verifies the result against the previous commit and commits it to the orphan
#      data-archive branch.
# It never pushes to the code branch and never force-pushes; artifacts from
# pull_request, fork or untrusted-branch runs are never read (same rules as
# .github/scripts/ledger.sh). The sweep also covers runs whose archive job was replaced
# while queued (the concurrency group keeps one pending run), so nothing is missed when
# many deploys finish close together.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Snapshot job boards", "Deploy to GitHub Pages", "Monthly data refresh"]
    types: [completed]
  schedule:
    - cron: "37 9 * * *" # daily safety net, after snapshot.yml (06:17) and pages.yml (07:41)
    - cron: "23 4 1 * *" # monthly: freeze last month's comparisons and write its report (January: the annual review)
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      verify_history:
        description: "Also re-verify this many past data-branch commits (0 = skip)"
        required: false
        default: "0"

permissions:
  contents: read

# Artifacts are only read from trusted runs (REVIEW.md V2; scripts/archive/sweep.js).
env:
  TRUSTED_BRANCHES: claude/stoic-ride-54ddxp

# Shared with archive-backfill.yml: two archive runs never interleave on the data branch.
concurrency:
  group: archive
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # contents: write is allowed for this job by name in test/workflows.test.js (it pushes only
  # the orphan data-archive branch; scripts/archive/branch.sh refuses main and claude/*).
  archive-ingest:
    name: Ingest into the data-archive branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: write # push the orphan data-archive branch (never the code branch)
      actions: read   # list and download workflow artifacts
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERIFY_HISTORY: ${{ inputs.verify_history || '0' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Open the data-archive branch
        env:
          ARCHIVE_DEPTH: ${{ (inputs.verify_history && inputs.verify_history != '0') && '400' || '1' }}
        run: |
          echo "ARCHIVE=$RUNNER_TEMP/archive" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          bash scripts/archive/branch.sh open "$RUNNER_TEMP/archive"

      - name: Migrate the schema if the code is newer, then verify before ingesting
        run: |
          node scripts/archive/migrate.js --archive "$ARCHIVE"
          node scripts/archive/verify.js --archive "$ARCHIVE"
          case "$VERIFY_HISTORY" in ''|0|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) node scripts/archive/verify.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --history "$VERIFY_HISTORY" ;; esac

      - name: Sweep artifacts, verify and commit
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          for i in $(seq 1 20); do
            if [ "$SECONDS" -gt 3600 ]; then echo "::warning::time budget used; the next run continues"; break; fi
            node scripts/archive/sweep.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --max 3 --run-cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/runs.json"
            rc=$?
            if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 10 ]; then echo "::error::sweep failed (exit $rc)"; exit "$rc"; fi
            node scripts/archive/verify.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --prev-rev HEAD || { echo "::error::archive verify failed; nothing from this batch is committed"; exit 1; }
            bash scripts/archive/branch.sh commit "$ARCHIVE" "archive: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%MZ) ($(node scripts/archive/status.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --oneline))" || exit 1
            [ "$rc" -eq 10 ] || break
          done

      - name: Reference data, monthly comparisons and reports
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/archive/record.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --from-repo
          node scripts/archive/monthly.js --archive "$ARCHIVE"
          node scripts/archive/report.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --auto
          node scripts/archive/reconstruct.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --check-all
          node scripts/archive/verify.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --prev-rev HEAD
          bash scripts/archive/branch.sh commit "$ARCHIVE" "archive: reference data, monthly comparisons and reports ($(date -u +%Y-%m-%d))"

      - name: Summary
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: |
          if [ -f "$ARCHIVE/MANIFEST.json" ]; then
            node scripts/archive/status.js --archive "$ARCHIVE" --markdown | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
values..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test (Node ${{ matrix.node }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [20, 22]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
          cache: npm

      - name: Install
        run: npm ci

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test

      # Warn-only staleness gate (docs/DATA_FRESHNESS.md): a step-summary table of every
      # dataset's age plus a warning per entry past its cadence + grace. Never fails CI.
      - name: Data freshness (warn only)
        if: matrix.node == 22
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/refresh/run.js --staleness

      - name: Static build (GitHub Pages bundle)
        run: |
          npm run build
          jq -e 'type == "array" and length >= 3' dist/api/companies.json
          for f in dist/api/jobs/*.json; do jq -e '.jobs | type == "array"' "$f" > /dev/null; done
          test -f dist/config.js && test -f dist/.nojekyll && test -f dist/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js
          # Lazy descriptions: lists carry no HTML, each job has a desc file.
          jq -e '[.jobs[] | select(has("descriptionHtml") and .descriptionHtml != "")] | length == 0' dist/api/jobs/anthropic.json
          test -n "$(find dist/api/desc -name '*.json' -print -quit)"
          # Juice Score: inputs and module are bundled; juice itself is never stored in lists.
          test -f dist/lib/juice.js
          jq -e '(.cities | type == "array") and (.cities | length > 0)' dist/api/cities.json > /dev/null
          for f in dist/api/jobs/*.json; do jq -e '[.jobs[] | select(has("juice"))] | length == 0' "$f" > /dev/null; done
          # v2 (1-up): packed-2 lists with meta, plus per-company history and meta files.
          for f in dist/api/jobs/*.json; do
            slug=$(basename "$f" .json)
            jq -e '.format == "melon-packed-2" and (.meta | has("compstimate") and has("history"))' "$f" > /dev/null
            jq -e 'type == "object"' "dist/api/history/$slug.json" > /dev/null
            jq -e 'has("compstimate") and has("history")' "dist/api/meta/$slug.json" > /dev/null
          done

      - name: Smoke test (start server, hit API)
        env:
          PORT: 5173
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm start > server.log 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          trap 'kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

          # Wait up to ~30s for the server to come up.
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/companies" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

          echo "::group::GET /api/companies"
          curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/companies" | tee companies.json | jq .
          echo "::endgroup::"
          jq -e 'type == "array" and length >= 3 and (map(.slug) | index("anthropic") != null)' companies.json

          echo "::group::GET /api/jobs?company=anthropic"
          curl -fsS --max-time 90 "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/jobs?company=anthropic" > jobs.json
          jq '{mode, fetchedAt, error, company: .company.slug, count: (.jobs | length)}' jobs.json
          echo "::endgroup::"
          jq -e '(.jobs | type == "array") and (.mode | IN("live","cache","snapshot","demo"))' jobs.json

      - name: Server log
        if: always()
        run: cat server.log || true

  # External links (scripts/external-links.js; docs/process/devops.md decision
  # 66). GitHub's runners can reach the internet; the dev sandbox can't. One run
  # per push/PR, outside the Node matrix. Broken links are listed in the step
  # summary. Job postings close daily, so the job-URL and doc-URL steps are
  # advisory; the site's own pages must answer, or CI fails.
  links:
    name: External links
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      SITE_URL: ${{ vars.SITE_URL || 'https://alvations.github.io/melon-seek/' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22

      # 20 Apply URLs per built-in company, seeded by the UTC date (reruns on
      # the same day pick the same jobs; the seed is in the summary). Source:
      # the deployed site's built lists (a CI build has no snapshots, so its
      # lists are demo data with synthetic URLs).
      - name: Job Apply URLs (advisory)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/external-links.js --jobs "$SITE_URL" --per-company 20 --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Doc URLs in README.md and docs/**/*.md (advisory)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/external-links.js --docs --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      # Advisory here: CI starts on the same push as the Pages deploy, so it races it and can
      # catch the old site, or the branch build's holding page (repo-root index.html), mid-deploy.
      # The hard live-site gate is pages.yml's post-deploy check (check-site.sh) after the deploy.
      - name: Site pages (advisory; pages.yml's post-deploy check is the gate)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: node scripts/external-links.js --site --summary "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
